title: Composition of the strict restricted Roos comparisons
statement: Fix l prime, a finite extension E of Q_l, and composable scheme isomorphisms h:Z→W and f:W→V, with l invertible in all residue fields. Let A be a PodReindexFamily [def-pod-completion-reindex-coherence] satisfying the PodCompletionReindex.Laws [def-pod-completion-reindex-models] for f,h,h≫f. Assume its ordinary compositor a:H≅F⋙G acts on original sections by restriction along the inverse Over.mapComp(h,f) arrow, with F=isoReductionIntegralInverse(f), G=isoReductionIntegralInverse(h), H=isoReductionIntegralInverse(h≫f). For a strict coefficient sequence complex C [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems], put Cf=sequencePullback_f(C), let sigma be the strict sequence compositor at C, and T(sigma) its restricted tower map. Write R(C) for podRestrictedTower(C), r_f for the supplied Roos comparison, and t_f(C) for its restricted tower comparison. Write alpha:HC→FC⋙GC for the cochain transformation of a.hom. Then alpha_(Roos R(C)) ≫ GC(r_f(R(C))) ≫ GC(Roos(t_f(C))) ≫ r_h(R(Cf)) ≫ Roos(t_h(Cf)) = r_(h≫f)(R(C)) ≫ Roos(t_(h≫f)(C)) ≫ Roos(T(sigma)). This is equality of whole strict cochain maps before localization, for every unbounded C.

proof.text: RoosFst and RoosSnd identify each supplied Roos comparison with scalarRoosMap. Both coordinate formulas are the canonical ones; compose mappingCocone.id_X with the two candidate maps in degree i to identify them from the two coordinates.

The restricted-tower composition theorem, followed by cancellation of the inverse ordinary tower compositor, identifies the composite restricted map followed by T(sigma) with the forward ordinary tower compositor followed by the two successive restricted maps. Naturality of scalarRoosMap moves the first restricted map past the h Roos comparison. Apply the generic composition theorem for scalarRoosMap. The strict Roos functor sends the restricted-tower equation to the equality of the remaining factors. Thus the strict composition square commutes.

theorem podCompositionRestrictedRoos
    {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ V) [IsIso h] [IsIso f]
    [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (A : PodReindexFamily l E)
    (hf : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f))
    (hh : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E h (A.completion h))
    (hc : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E (h ≫ f) (A.completion (h ≫ f)))
    (ha : ∀ (M : scalarReductionSource l E V) (U : Z.ProEt)
      (x : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose (h ≫ f)).obj U))),
      ((A.composition h f).hom.app M).val.app (op U) x =
        M.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.mapComp (Q := ⊤)
          (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale h) (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale f)).inv.app U).op x)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E V) ℤ) :
    let Cf := ((integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C
    let σ := (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
      (integralComparisonSequenceComposition l E h f).hom (.up ℤ)).app C
    let Tσ := HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map
      (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E Z).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map σ)
    let α : isoReductionIntegralComplex l E (h ≫ f) ⟶
        isoReductionIntegralComplex l E f ⋙ isoReductionIntegralComplex l E h :=
      NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (A.composition h f).hom (.up ℤ)
    α.app (integralOperationsRoos (podRestrictedTower l E C)) ≫
      (isoReductionIntegralComplex l E h).map
        ((A.completion f).roos (podRestrictedTower l E C)).hom ≫
      (isoReductionIntegralComplex l E h).map
        (integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map ((A.completion f).restricted C).hom) ≫
      ((A.completion h).roos (podRestrictedTower l E Cf)).hom ≫
      integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map ((A.completion h).restricted Cf).hom =
    ((A.completion (h ≫ f)).roos (podRestrictedTower l E C)).hom ≫
      integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map ((A.completion (h ≫ f)).restricted C).hom ≫
      integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map Tσ
